summary: Keep literal Unicode case-folded local searches, selected MCP storage paths, and existing parent-directory permissions intact. Keep all credential-shaped test fixtures wholly synthetic.
reason: Google Voice searches must match the documented substrings in existing mirrors, MCP must use the operator-selected account home, and opening a mirror must reject unsafe existing directories without chmod side effects. One inherited cookie-shaped regression fixture came from an older upstream browser capture; replace it and the opaque JWT header with invented values while preserving shape coverage.
validated_outcome: Regression tests cover substring and punctuation queries, accented and multi-rune case folding on read-only existing mirrors, custom-home subprocess launch and printed settings, and rejecting shared directories without creating a DB or changing permissions.
